name: tulpar
displayName: Tulpar — Figma & screenshots to verified components
description: Turn a Figma frame or a screenshot into a component built with your design system — React, Vue, Angular or Web Components — then build, render and check it against the design before you see it.

commands.title: Generate component from Figma or a screenshot
Verify this file against a Figma frame (local repository)

tulpar.server.description: The Tulpar server that generates components with your account.

tulpar.repoPath.description: Optional: a local copy of the Tulpar repository (the folder containing cli/src/main.ts). When set, generation runs on this machine with its own keys (.env) instead of tulparsi.com, and "Verify this file" is available.

tulpar.nodePath.description: Node.js 24 or newer, for the local repository mode.
